sources.finding: Both native selects include 미설정 with empty value. Selecting it calls onChange(''), yielding both endpoints unset. A nonempty endpoint fills the missing counterpart; crossing endpoints adjusts the other endpoint in one callback.

onFieldChange calls setDraft. setPersistedDraft immediately updates local draft reference and expiring local storage then React state. Previous/Next only route; Next validates locally. Final onSubmit invokes createTeamMatch.mutate. Cancel/leave does not mean draft removal.
ConditionFields renders the range component and forwards its onChange to grade field callback. Other form values are separate; existing mixed-label selector remains.

scope: Select/title UI-only changes may persist locally and refresh TTL. Restore original UI values explicitly. Do not save/create/upload or inspect/inject malformed draft storage.
limitations: Static exact-commit source, not a live network/API/DB audit. No runtime SHA confirmation.
